# nRnWorld
> Open Windows tools, AI agents, audio engines and browser games. 19 projects with direct downloads and source on GitHub (@nRn-World).

## Projects
- [ShadowPaw: Noir Typist](https://nrnworld.one/shadowpaw): https://nrnworld.one/shadowpaw: Retro noir typing thriller where words become powers, reality reacts to your keys, and every chapter pushes you deeper into the truth. | Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/ShadowPaw/ | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/ShadowPaw
- [Doggy-Player](https://nrnworld.one/doggyplayer): https://nrnworld.one/doggyplayer: High-fidelity audio & video desktop media player with customized skinning, EQ, and gapless playback. | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/Doggy-Player
- [WindowsSmartTaskbar](https://nrnworld.one/windowssmarttaskbar): https://nrnworld.one/windowssmarttaskbar: Sleek Windows system tray utility for smart application organization and taskbar decluttering. | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/WindowsSmartTaskbar
- [NOBreak-Audio-Builder](https://nrnworld.one/nobreakaudiobuilder): https://nrnworld.one/nobreakaudiobuilder: Professional desktop audio mixer for creating seamless, gapless audio compilations. | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/NOBreak-Audio-Builder
- [OctosArmy](https://nrnworld.one/octosarmy): https://nrnworld.one/octosarmy: Multi-agent AI orchestration system for autonomous file management and workspace hygiene. | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/OctosArmy
- [TheSilentRoom1986](https://nrnworld.one/thesilentroom1986): https://nrnworld.one/thesilentroom1986: A 1980s-inspired underground typing game where your words manifest into reality to defy the regime. | Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/TheSilentRoom1986/ | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/TheSilentRoom1986
- [Farm-Guardian-TD](https://nrnworld.one/farmguardiantd): https://nrnworld.one/farmguardiantd: Modern mobile animal tower-defense and merge game built with Phaser 3 and TypeScript. | Live: https://farm-guardian-td.vercel.app | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/Farm-Guardian-TD
- [NeonPathPuzzle](https://nrnworld.one/neonpathpuzzle): https://nrnworld.one/neonpathpuzzle: Challenging neon light pathfinding and circuit alignment logic game. | Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/NeonPathPuzzle/ | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/NeonPathPuzzle
- [DoneTogether](https://nrnworld.one/donetogether): https://nrnworld.one/donetogether: Real-time collaborative planning app for teams and friends, built with React, TypeScript, and Firebase. | Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/DoneTogether/ | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/DoneTogether
- [NexNote](https://nrnworld.one/nexnote): https://nrnworld.one/nexnote: Minimalist, distraction-free markdown note-taking suite with instant live preview and KaTeX math. | Live: https://nexnote.vercel.app | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/NexNote
- [SecretPromts](https://nrnworld.one/secretpromts): https://nrnworld.one/secretpromts: Curated AI prompt discovery directory, tester, and optimization playground. | Live: https://secretpromts.vercel.app | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/SecretPromts
- [SiteScannerPro](https://nrnworld.one/sitescannerpro): https://nrnworld.one/sitescannerpro: Website health analysis for SEO, performance, security, accessibility, and code quality. | Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/SiteScannerPro/ | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/SiteScannerPro
- [GLOBAL_EMERGENCY](https://nrnworld.one/globalemergency): https://nrnworld.one/globalemergency: Global Emergency, source-backed country emergency information and travel safety PWA. | Live: https://nrn-world.github.io/GLOBAL_EMERGENCY/ | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/GLOBAL_EMERGENCY
- [PrivateLinkSaver](https://nrnworld.one/privatelinksaver): https://nrnworld.one/privatelinksaver: A secure Chrome extension to privately save, organize, and manage bookmarks with password protection. | Live: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/privatelinksaver/kdnhcpdhlpopdggnbkechdkcdbolkinf?hl=sv | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/PrivateLinkSaver
- [BUGRAIDER](https://nrnworld.one/bugraider): https://nrnworld.one/bugraider: Drop it into any AI agent and watch it hunt every bug, security flaw, and dead code in your project. | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/BUGRAIDER
- [BluetoothSafetyLock](https://nrnworld.one/bluetoothsafetylock): https://nrnworld.one/bluetoothsafetylock: Automated proximity lock utility that secures your Windows workstation when your Bluetooth device disconnects. | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/BluetoothSafetyLock
- [FlashVideoDownloader](https://nrnworld.one/flashvideodownloader): https://nrnworld.one/flashvideodownloader: Lightweight video stream discovery and downloader script. | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/FlashVideoDownloader
- [NotePin](https://nrnworld.one/notepin): https://nrnworld.one/notepin: Minimalist sticky note desktop pin utility for quick thoughts. | GitHub: https://github.com/nRn-World/NotePin
